features: Powerful Sound with Deep Bass - Experience rich and balanced sound with VS102 Plus wireless earbuds, delivering deep bass, clear vocals, and crisp highs for music, movies, and everyday audio.
Quad Mic ENC for Clear Call Quality - Enjoy crystal-clear calls with bluetooth earbuds featuring Quad Mic ENC that reduces background noise and ensures your voice is heard clearly in every call.
Up to 70 Hours Playtime + Instacharge - Stay powered all day with wireless earbuds offering up to 70 hours of total playtime. Get up to 120 minutes of playback with just 10 minutes of charging.
Stylish Flybird Design & Lightweight Fit - Stand out with a sleek Flybird design. These earbuds are lightweight, stylish, and comfortable for all-day wear, perfect for daily use and travel.
11mm Drivers for Immersive Audio - Equipped with powerful 11mm drivers, these bluetooth earbuds deliver immersive sound with enhanced bass and detailed audio for music and calls.
